mentions.name: Floors Check
mentions.description: A programmatic ads debugging tool with Prebid flooring insights (using an LLM to generate summaries), screenshots at various times, real-time console logs, and Prebid detection.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Shipped a new programmatic ads debugging tool https://floors-check.mile.so/ .

It has these capabilities for now :
- Prebid flooring insights ( uses an LLM to generate a summary )

- screenshot at various times

- real time console logs

- Prebid detection
